changes: == 🏪 BUSINESSES ==

New layouts at several businesses. Counters, menus, registers, storage and boss menus moved to better spots at Pearls, Gelato, Bean Machine, Stroke Master Mechanic, Skeeters (Stroke Master Bar), Rex Diner, Tequi-la-la and Ohana.
Charge Customer / Order Register now only appears at the register, not on every prompt.
Skeeters now has a grill for its food menu.
ZP Armory: storage moved, and storage prompts no longer show the register options.
Business supplies now come from the Wholesale supplies ped. Every business job can buy there. The old "Buy Ingredients/Supplies" prompts at businesses are gone.
Gelato: you now stay clocked in anywhere near the shop.
City Hall:
-> The DOJ boss menu is at the City Hall office desk.
-> Weapon license copies are only offered to license holders.
-> Buying a hunting licence now gives you a hunting licence.
== 🌿 WEED SHOPS ==
New weed shop: White Widow.
LD Organics, Bird's Pharmacy, High Supply, High Notes, Blaze It and White Widow each have their own strains, with picking, trimming, drying and blunt rolling at the shop.
High Notes:
-> There's now a working elevator between the main floor and the rooftop.
-> It has a new register.
== 💼 JOBS ==
New on 4.0: the Scrapyard. Strip wrecked cars for parts with a wrench.
Crafting ingredients now spoil after 7 days.
== 🎨 GANGS ==
New gangs: Lost, Revenant, Saints, Angels Of Death and McFinily.
Removed gangs: Ballas, Dreamchasers, FTW, GSF and Wilkens.
Lost MC is now "Lost" and keeps its garage.
Territory spray: order sprays from your gang menu for $2,500 cash per can, then collect them at one of five random pickup spots.
New spray tag art for many gangs.
Gang and job changes now apply straight away, with no relog needed.
== 🚓 POLICE ==
The armory now issues the Coil C9 taser. The standard taser is still available too.
== 💊 CRIME ==
Chop shop: the chassis payout is fixed.
== 🎒 ITEMS ==
Fish cooler: now 25 slots, 150 kg (was 20 slots, 200 kg).
Fixed the swapped Carbon Rod / Pro Rod pictures and the Rusted Car Bolts picture.
== 🚗 VEHICLES ==
Fuel use is halved, so a tank lasts twice as long.
New prompt style for pushing vehicles.
== 🗺️ MAPS ==
New: Gabz Tuners, Gabz Atom, Blockbudz and the Ocean Garage.
== 🛠️ FIXES ==
Various fixes and stability improvements.
Serpent Society launch: Henry and "An Intro to Crime" (Paleto house job), Alex's Tech Support quest, the boost training quest, the hideout door, Nico the new fence, and the calling-card item
White Widow dispensary job: 40 weed items, picking, trimming, drying, blunt rolling, 2 trim benches, boss menu, storages. "Buy Supplies" sells backwoods only ($20)
Viper LSPD livery for PD cars (Monarch, Dorado, V-STR, Dominator, Granger), selectable in the livery menu
19 EMS (tstudio med) vehicles registered properly
== 🛠️ FIXES / BALANCE ==
Oxy exploit fixed
Corner selling alerts police changes
Weed harvest works without the prop; wild weed watering/pesticide/fertilizer now actually apply
Money order fixes
VIP apartment stashes at the 3.5 sizes
Removed pistols/SMGs in daily rewards (never supposed to be there)
Megaphone hold pose fixed
Car crash damage multiplier 2.0 -> 0.5
Business zones: one broken business can no longer hide every other business's prompts
== 💼 JOBS & ECONOMY ==
📦 FedUp warehouse recycling deposits now give more materials
🎣 Fishing: fish now weigh their real weight in your inventory, so coolers fill up properly
🧊 Fish coolers have been rebalanced
🖼️ Fixed the Carbon Rod and Pro Rod inventory pictures being swapped
🍹 Pearls: the drinks crafting station has moved to the new counter
== 🚔 POLICE / EMS / DOJ ==
⚖️ New DOJ (lawyer) boss menu
🔗 Escorting is stricter: you can only escort someone who is cuffed, downed or in last stand
🚑 EMS vehicles got updated handling
== 🏠 HOUSING ==
📦 Apartment stashes can now hold more
🔄 Fixed "Change Character" doing nothing while inside a property
== 🔫 CRIME & HEISTS ==
🌿 Weed planting: the "Check" prompt on plants no longer disappears and comes back
== 🚗 VEHICLES ==
🛹 Skateboards no longer lose wheels or stop working on impact
== 🗑️ REMOVED ==
💻 Unused hacks and cracking minigames have been taken out for now
== 🚗 VEHICLES ==
Promo Merula is now a 6-seater with improved handling
New PD vehicles + handling updates (Regent, Terminus, Buffalo HF, Merit)
NPC cars now use a different plate format from player cars, so plates can never clash
Boat fish cooler added (each boat has its own)
Boat anchor is back
Civ job vehicles no longer need servicing
== 🔧 MECHANICS ==
Repair kits added
Mech tablet now required ($500)
Servicing is for owned vehicles only
== 💰 ECONOMY & PAYMENTS ==

Your bank balance can no longer go below $0 (ps if you exploited the fish market, your balance will stay negative, and we have noted down how you operate. Take the negative balance as your warning to do better we know who you are, You aint slick)
Only PD fines (/fine, police bills, MDT fines) can still put you in the negative, so pay your fines!
Business POS now refuses a charge if the customer can't afford it
Payments can no longer go through without the money
== 🏪 BUSINESSES ==
Rabbit, UwU, Pearls (now with kiosk) and Hayes updated
== ⚖️ DOJ & POLICE ==
New DOJ ranks: Paralegal, Associate, Senior Associate, Partner, Managing Partner
Existing lawyers have been moved to Associate
MDT charges lowered to match the economy
Robberies: if you're not wearing real gloves, you WILL leave fingerprints
== 💊 CRIME ==
Coke run updated
Oxy Runs are now live
Store robbery evidence improved
Laundromat heist updated
== 🛠️ FIXES ==
Bigfoot walk removed
Fixes for civilian jobs, clothing and EMS
== 🏪 WHISPERS FROM BELOW ==
Word on the street says there’s been a place under the city all along. Most people have driven right past it.

items.date: 11/3/26 -> 👕 Quick Clothing Menu, HUD & Business Update
changes: == 👕 CLOTHING ==
New quick clothing menu: hold Y. Take off or put back on your hat, glasses, mask, top, shirt, gloves, pants, shoes, bag and more with one click.
Move and resize it in the HUD editor: open the editor, switch on "Clothing panel" in the components list, then drag it and use the mouse wheel to resize.
Clothing store: every tab starts with a free "None" option, there is an ID mode for hair, face and overlays, and "Gloves & Rings" is now "Arms".
Speedometer follows your game setting, so km/h players finally see km/h.
Quest card stays where you drag it and can't be lost off-screen.
Car radio key no longer pops an error when you're on foot.
Server status (Home): new "Officer Hostage" row that turns green when 8 or more officers are on duty.
EMS on duty see player IDs up to 100 m away (Home key), so finding patients is easier.
== 🚓 POLICE ==
Vehicle megaphone works: front seat of a PD car, press K. A green "MEGAPHONE ON" shows and everyone nearby hears you.
Car thefts and carjackings show up in the MDT dispatch and recent calls, not just as a pop-up.
== 🅿️ PARKING METERS ==
Robbing a meter now uses the interact prompt (E) instead of the eye.
You need a Toolkit (screwdriver set); the minigame and messages work properly.
== 🍔 BUSINESSES & POS ==
Clearer register: staff see "Charge a customer / Send bill to customer"; customers see "You are paying this business", with who billed you and the total.
Real item names and pictures on bills, receipts, the register and the order kiosk (no more item codes or blank images).
Choose how much to craft at restaurant stations; the time scales with the amount (up to 50 at once).
Cat Cafe:
-> The menu spot is now an ordering kiosk ("Order Food").
-> You can also order at the registers.
-> Every food and drink on the menu can now be made.
-> The register and menu heights are fixed.
-> There is a new packaging spot.
"Buy Materials" removed from Ammu-Nation.
"Charge Customer" register option removed.
== 🚗 DEALERSHIPS ==
PDM: about 500 regular GTA cars added (armed, armored, military and gimmick vehicles left out).
Display cars are back at the donator dealership. Spinning showcase cars, buy them with Gold Coins, and take a test drive first.
== 🛒 STORES ==
24/7s sell plain water (for farming and weed planting).
Store clerks no longer appear twice.
Stray "Open Store" prompts are gone from the Paleto hunting store.
== 🛠️ FIXES ==
The speed limiter works again.
Emote entitlements load without errors.
Ammo materials from the quarry. Lead, Brass and Sulfur now come from mining. Grab a pickaxe and get swinging.
No more rocks in your pockets. Mining no longer gives Stone, so your inventory can breathe again.
Every swing counts. Each hit on a rock now always gives you something.
Pickaxes are at the Hardware Store and the Metal Detector Store.
== 👗 NEW: "NONE" IN EVERY CATEGORY ==
Every clothing tab now starts with a None option, so you can take off just your top, pants, shoes, mask, bag and so on.
It's always free, and it shows up in changing rooms and with "Show only add-ons" turned on.
== 🔢 ID MODE EVERYWHERE ==
The hair, face and makeup tabs now have an ID MODE switch (top right).
Turn it on to see the number of every hairstyle, hair color, highlight, face, eye color, skin tone, beard, eyebrows and makeup style.
It uses the same on/off setting as ID mode in the clothing filter.
== 🔄 UPDATE YOUR SAVED OUTFITS ==
New Update button (circle arrow) on each outfit in My Outfits.
It replaces the outfit with what you're wearing now, keeps its name, and keeps its share code, so anyone you shared it with gets the new version.
It asks before replacing anything.
== ✏️ RENAMED ==
"Gloves & Rings" is now Arms.
== 🅿️ PARKING METER ROBBERY ==
The city's parking meters have been feeling a little too generous with your loose change. That's over.
One spot for meter robbery. No more two different prompts on the same meter.
Tool change: meters now need a different tool to get open. Figure out which one 😉
Faster grab. Emptying a meter is quicker now, so you're in and out before the meter maid shows up.
Changes to what you find inside. Crack a few open and see for yourself 👀
Watch your back. Cops may still get a call, and an emptied meter needs time to fill back up.
== 🔫 AMMO CRAFTING PARTS FINALLY STACK ==

Crafting ammo used to turn your pockets into a casing museum, with every bullet tip, casing and pinch of gunpowder taking its own slot. Now bullet tips, gunpowder, small/large/shotgun casings and shotgun pellets all stack. Crafted ammo parts now take up one slot each instead of ten.
Casings you already have won't merge on their own. Drag them onto each other to stack them.
== 🩸 CIVILIANS ARE NO LONGER CRIME SCENE INVESTIGATORS ==
Pulling out a camera or filming on your phone used to show civilians every blood splatter on the street. Your camera is a camera again, not a forensics kit. Only police can see evidence now.
== 👊 THE CASHIER HAS BEEN TO ANGER MANAGEMENT ==

Our cashier had been fighting back, refusing to die, and beating customers up behind the counter. He's been talked down. Now when you pull a gun or hit the register, he does what any sane minimum-wage worker would do: he runs. And he runs for everyone, so you'll all see the same scared man sprinting for the door.
== 💰 REGISTERS NOW PAY WHAT'S ACTUALLY IN THEM ==
The register was keeping a cut for itself. Bugs were eating part of the money every robbery, so you never got the full drawer. Now you get the whole pot, every single dollar.
Emptying a register now takes 3 minutes. Same money, more suspense. Keep your eyes on the door.
Heisters empty it faster and grab an extra 10% on top.
== 🚪 THE FRONT DOORS STOPPED TRAPPING YOU INSIDE ==
The store doors were locking during robberies and getting stuck. They've been fixed and won't lock you in anymore. Your getaway is back in your hands.
== 🍀 LUCKY ACTUALLY MAKES YOU LUCKY NOW ==
The Lucky skill was making you less likely to find good loot. It now works the right way and boosts your chances.
Registers have a base chance to drop a gatecrack, and Lucky raises it.
== 🔫 AMMU-NATION'S MYSTERY CLERK HAS BEEN LET GO ==
A clerk was still standing around in Ammu-Nation, which isn't even open. He's gone. We wish him well.
== 🧹 BEHIND-THE-SCENES CLEANUP ==
We fixed some background errors and made things more stable, so robberies should feel smoother all around.
A huge one! Dozens of fixes and new features across the whole city. These should have gone live with the last restart. Here's everything that's new.
== 🏋️ GYMS & SKILLS ==

Two gym skill scripts were running at the same time. One of them came bundled with some of our gym maps. It was badly broken, far too easy to level, and was never meant to be in the game. Some players maxed their gym stats in about 4 hours and ended up with insane speed and other buffs. That script has now been removed.
Any points earned in that old system have been converted into the skill system we actually use, so your progress isn't lost.
This is our first time running a skills and gym system, so further tweaks may be needed to keep things balanced.
Gyms now level a variety of skills in the main skill trees, and the old gym stat buffs are gone.
Everyone who trained at the old gyms gets a one-time Strength XP bonus based on their old stats.
Skill progression has been rebalanced, and daily XP caps have been added.
A way to earn Intelligence XP has been fixed.
== 🔧 MECHANICS & VEHICLES ==
New Basic Repair Kit: gets your engine running again
New Mechanic's Repairkit for mechanic shops.
Mechanic shop repairs have been fixed.
Speed limit: vehicles are capped at 160 mph, like 3.5.
Garage and rental cars no longer disappear when you take them out.
Passengers can see the speedometer.
Shared GPS: passengers can set the waypoint for everyone in the car.
Boat Imports: the clerk now faces the right way.
== 🚓 POLICE ==
Searches have been improved.
First aid kits have been fixed.
Armoury update: new pricing and updated gear.
Officer down alerts now go to police only.
Spike strips: no more errors when they're placed.
EMS no longer get "officer down" alerts meant for police.
EMS and police units now show in different colours on the MDT.
Much faster MDT loading.
Arrests now show on citizen profiles.
Warrant and bulletin expiry dates now save correctly.
Judges and lawyers now appear in the phone's Services app.
Radio channel 4 is now available to on-duty judges and lawyers.
== 📻 RADIO ==
Channels 911 and 912 are now public.
== 🍔 FOOD, DRINK & ITEMS ==
Store water and tosti can be used again.
Crafted items no longer land in your locked quick slot.
Inventory weight display is cleaner, and General Shop stock is fixed.
== 🏠 HOUSING & BUSINESSES ==
You can now change characters from inside your property.
Boss menus: changing ranks works again.
Gang chop shop tax has been fixed.
Stores open faster, and store robberies are rebalanced.
== 🧭 QUALITY OF LIFE ==
Last Location spawn now puts you exactly where you logged out.
== ⚡ PERFORMANCE & STABILITY ==
Several fixes that cut down on server lag.
Database tuning for faster loading across the city.
Debug spam removed from the server.
New performance tracking to help us find lag faster.
⚠️ If you run into any issues with these changes, please let us know in the testing channels so we can get them sorted.
== 📻 RADIO & HUD ==
New car radio: built into the HUD, with YouTube, a boombox, and you can move it in the HUD editor
Radio members list: see who's on your channel and who's talking
Voice ring: turns green when you talk, and shows your range
New scoreboard, and the old radio scripts are retired
Mechanic shops show their real names. No more "Benny's" everywhere.
All 21 gun stores are on the map, and hardware stores are labeled
Garages match 3.5, and rentals have their own category
Plants are back, and jail sends you to the new intake spot
== 🔧 MECHANICS & BUSINESSES ==
Repairs are a flat price, done by real mechanics. Benny's self-service is gone.
Mechanic jobs are set up for every shop
StreetEats no longer lists gun stores
Armory Seoul and PDM Ammunition have new layouts
== 🚓 POLICE & 🚑 EMS ==
Fixed police armory items and prices
Personal lockers
MDT: Set Radio works, no more freezes, fight alerts off, IA date fix
Impound tells you where seized cars go
EMS: call a doctor when no EMS is on, and calls reliably reach EMS
Top speed is capped at 160 mph, like 3.5
== 🕶️ LIFE PATHS & ILLEGAL ==
Racer: pink slip races, and starter car keys only work for you
Chop shop options work again
Serpent Society crew is back, with Mr. Porcoddio
Alta Tower and Cook Off: coming soon
== ⚙️ OTHER ==
Pickaxe added, and attachments are their own items
Gold coin codes can be redeemed again
Dumpster prompts are back, and hunting is closed for launch
Clothing names and prices no longer cut off
Test commands locked down, plus stability fixes
Discord status shows Viper Roleplay 4.0
